compileRelease.source: telemetry.collectorRuntime property, applied as options.release by the telemetry.library convention plugin

modules.note: options.release=11 produces class file major version 55. The verifyCollectorBytecode check in this module requires major 55, so this module must stay at release 11.

modules.diagnostic: options.release=11 comes from the telemetry.library convention and overrides the module toolchain (21). The report sources use Java 21 APIs (a record and List.getFirst / List.getLast), so javac with --release 11 rejects them at :report:compileJava.
